description: This is a unit test class for the LeaveConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It contains test methods to verify configuration retrieval and setting functions related to leave management, utilizing mocking for dependencies.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveConfigurationService's configuration retrieval and update methods.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave entitlement consumption strategy setting via mocked ConfigDao.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of work schedule implementation setting.

methods.name: testIncludePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Tests the inclusion of pending leave in balance calculation based on configuration value.

methods.name: getIncludePendingLeaveInBalanceDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing includePendingLeaveInBalance method.

methods.name: testSetIsLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Tests setting the leave period as defined using mocked ConfigDao.

methods.name: testIsLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Verifies if the leave period is correctly identified as defined.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the leave period status setting.

methods.name: testSetLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Tests updating the leave period status configuration.
